exact: modulation by symbiont of host systemic acquired resistance
modulation by symbiont of systemic acquired resistance in host
perturbation of host systemic acquired resistance
broad: modulation by organism of systemic acquired resistance in other organism involved in symbiotic interaction

definition: A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts systemic acquired resistance in the host organism; systemic acquired resistance is a salicylic acid-mediated response that confers broad spectrum systemic resistance. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host systemic acquired resistance
